title: Do these 3 every day this week during nap time, without a sound
caption: Quiet exercises to do during nap time: Glute Bridge, Doorframe Lean Row and Wall Sit, three rounds in about seven minutes. No jumping and nothing to drop, so the house stays quiet. Save this for nap time.

overlays.text: Do these 3 every day this week, during nap time.

scenes.footer: Hinge. Any patch of floor, not a sound.

overlays.text: Glute Bridge. 10 reps. Lie on your back, feet flat, lift your hips, lower slowly.

scenes.footer: Pull. Any doorframe except the nursery one.

overlays.text: Doorframe Lean Row. 10 reps. Hold the frame, lean back a little, pull yourself in.

scenes.footer: Squat. Holding still makes no sound at all.

overlays.text: Wall Sit. 30 seconds. Back flat on the wall, slide down until your knees bend, hold.
No push and no core this week. Both come back next week.

scenes.footer: You build this while she sleeps.

overlays.text: Three rounds of the three. About seven minutes, well inside one nap.
Which room will you use during nap time?
